source.creator: BaleGG
source.title: 🤯 EL VACÍO AHORA CUESTA 5 DE ELIXIR
source.source_kind: Creator recording of actual Clash Royale in-game card preview; current five-elixir Void card menu visible
source.viewed: Extracted actual video frames from public 1080p media section approximately 60–105s. Not a transcript-only inspection. Did not watch entire video.

timing_note: Video times are approximate because the downloaded section begins near the 60s keyframe. Frame interval comparisons within the same section are reliable; no claim of exact cast time to the millisecond.

observations: Warm orange/red cast flash near 67.7s, then a brief pink-white center intro column around 67.9s.
Compact dark burgundy/near-black ground pool expands around 68.1–68.5s, with thin orange/red hot rim and subtle interior red markings.
Three narrow magenta/pink-white damage strikes are visible around 69.3, 70.5, and 71.7s, approximately 1.2s apart.
Damage-beam endpoints attach to the current Bowler position as it advances. The ground pool stays at the cast center.
Bowler receives pink hit glow. Pool collapses/disappears around 71.9–72.1s, with residual small pink sparkle/glow near72.3s.
No field-wide long diagonal ray effect is visible in these frames.
Warm cast flash around86.2s, small pink center intro around86.4s, dark pool starts86.6s and reaches its full footprint by87.0s.
Frame87.75s clearly shows separate thin warm-orange vertical beam cores terminating at the five troop positions; the rear pair is above the pool center.
Three sampled hit windows occur around87.75,88.95,90.15s, approximately1.2s apart.
The beams move with the troops between hits while the pool remains at the original bridge cast point.
Multi-target hit flashes are bright yellow/cream with warm glow, visibly different from the single-target pink/white Bowler strikes.
Pool disappears around90.4s while surviving Barbarians retain brief purple hit/death-like particles.

findings: Both arena samples show one long vertical beam over the empty pool center while the three Knights are offset around it. The reference damage beams land at troop positions. A brief center intro column is present in the reference, but does not replace the subsequent target-attached damage strikes.

The captured Web Royale pool appears more brown/orange with a broad warm halo than the reference near-black burgundy pool with a narrow bright rim. This is visual comparison, not a calibrated color measurement.
comparison_to_pre_fix_webroyale.limits: Two still Web Royale frames do not establish full beam duration. No exact world-space radius claim was made from differently framed captures.

extraction.method: Normal unauthenticated public video media access through yt-dlp and ffmpeg; frame crops and contact sheets made without modifying source imagery beyond crop/scale and timestamp labels.
extraction.limits: A later independent section download returned403 and was not bypassed. Existing60–105s footage supplies all observations above.
